stemMd: A box holds red, blue and green tokens. Without looking, what is the minimum number that must be drawn to guarantee at least two of the same colour, assuming enough tokens of every colour?
explanationMd: At most three tokens can be drawn with all colours different. A fourth must repeat one of the three colours. This is the pigeonhole principle and gives the smallest guaranteed count.

distractorRationale.a: Two draws can have different colours.
distractorRationale.b: Three draws can include one of each colour.
distractorRationale.e: This is more than the minimum guarantee.
